title: Grateful Dead Live at Academy of Music on 1972-03-25

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with fair sound quality that still delivers a rare Bo Diddley blues set and a ten‑minute jam loved by fans.
ai_review.review: The recording suffers from muddy, feedback‑laden audio that makes it hard to enjoy, but the performance shines with an enthusiastic Bo Diddley blues segment (Hey Hey, Wow Wow, Slow Blues) and a standout ten‑minute jam on track 6. While the technical shortcomings keep some listeners from fully appreciating the show, the rare song selections and high energy make it a worthwhile listen for completists.

ai_rating.rationale: Show performance is praised for rare Bo Diddley tunes and strong jam, but multiple reviewers note poor audience‑tape sound that limits enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audio described as muddy, feedback‑ridden, and difficult to hear; occasional problematic sections (e.g., Slow Blues) but overall usable for content.

standout_songs: Bo Diddley blues set (Hey Hey, Wow Wow, Slow Blues)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Features a rare Bo Diddley blues medley and an extended improvisational jam; despite sound issues the flow is praised for its excitement and rarity.
